name: How long does it take to replace a tankless water heater?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a tankless water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The replacement process for a tankless water heater usually takes 4-8 hours, depending on the complexity of the installation and whether any plumbing modifications are needed. If upgrading from a traditional tank water heater to a tankless unit, the process can take longer due to venting and gas line adjustments. Our team prioritizes efficient service to minimize disruption to your hot water supply.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tankless water heater replacement typically takes 4-8 hours, varying with installation complexity.
